name: beehiiv
tagline: Newsletter publishing, growth, monetization, and email platform

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Scale listed at $49/month monthly and around $43/month annually in public coverage.

verdictSummary: You can build a newsletter CMS and send emails, but beehiiv's moat is deliverability, growth network, recommendations, ad marketplace, automations, analytics, and migrations.
coreLoopDIY: Create posts, maintain subscribers, send campaigns through an email provider, publish web archive, and show basic analytics.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because audience growth and email reliability are harder than writing and sending HTML.

priorArt.name: Ghost
priorArt.desc: Open-source publishing/newsletter platform with memberships and email support.

notes: Valuable 'kinda' because the network/monetization layer is the real reason to pay.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for beehiiv (Newsletter publishing, growth, monetization, and email platform). Requirements:

- Core loop: Create posts, maintain subscribers, send campaigns through an email provider, publish web archive, and show basic analytics.
- Needs: email service provider.
- Needs: domain/DNS auth.
- Needs: database.
- Needs: CMS/editor.
- Needs: unsubscribe/compliance.
- Needs: hosting.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: email deliverability; referral/recommendation network; ad network.
